If it existed before, explain what already existed and what you built or changed during the submission period.
fields.description: "N/A" if new project. We recommend explaining this in your text description too!

fields.label: Explain how your project meets the main technology requirement.
fields.description: Please name each PayPal tool and AI tool you used and what it does in your project. Requirement: Your project must integrate the PayPal developer platform (using the free sandbox environment) along with an AI tool, model, or platform of your choice.

fields.label: Which additional sponsor tool(s) did you use for this project?
fields.description: Reminder: Usage of a Paypal tool and an AI tool is required for all projects. Using the listed sponsors are optional.

fields.label: Provide a URL to your public code repository for judging and testing on GitHub.
fields.description: The code repository must be publicly available. Must include: approved OSI license, README with setup instructions, clear explanation of how you used PayPal and AI in your project, along with any other tools or technologies used, including sponsor integrations (e.g., APIMatic, Postman/Astro, Render).

fields.label: Provide a URL to a working demo, hosted application, or test build of your Project.
